patient.base: All labelled expression-linked TCGA-OV cases, including landmark exclusions
patient.derivation: Participant identifier retained from the unified clinical cohort

response4.meaning: Canonical first-course response: CR complete response, PR partial response, SD stable disease, PD progressive disease
response4.derivation: Canonical TCGA-CDR first-course outcome; clinical-matrix label does not override it

label_source.meaning: TCGA-CDR label availability and concordance with the clinical-matrix label
label_source.derivation: TCGA-CDR only, concordant clinical-matrix label, or discordant clinical-matrix label, as recorded in script 20

response_conflict.meaning: TRUE when both canonical and clinical-matrix response labels are available and disagree; FALSE otherwise
response_conflict.reference: FALSE; not evidence of concordance if the clinical-matrix label is unavailable
response_conflict.derivation: Comparison of canonicalized TCGA-CDR and clinical-matrix response labels

age.derivation: TCGA-CDR-linked survival age with clinical-matrix age used when unavailable

stage_group.meaning: FIGO stage grouped as I-II, III or IV
stage_group.base: All labelled TCGA-OV cases; adjusted models use available covariates
stage_group.derivation: Unified clinical stage grouped by script 02; unknown stage retained as NA

grade.meaning: Recorded histological grade, retaining original G1/G2/G3/G4/GB/GX codes
grade.reference: not applicable; GB/GX are retained codes, not silently recoded

residual_group.meaning: Postoperative residual disease: R0, 1-10 mm, 11-20 mm or >20 mm
residual_group.unit: residual disease category (mm; R0 means no macroscopic disease)
residual_group.base: All labelled TCGA-OV cases; adjusted models use available covariates

OS_days.meaning: Overall-survival follow-up interval from diagnosis to death or censoring
OS_days.reference: Diagnosis is day 0; 0 is not missing
OS_days.derivation: TCGA-CDR OS.time retained unchanged; not time since the therapy-end landmark

OS_event.derivation: TCGA-CDR OS event field retained unchanged

PFI_days.meaning: TCGA-CDR progression-free interval to a PFI event or censoring; not a response-assessment date
PFI_days.reference: Diagnosis is day 0; 0 is not missing
PFI_days.derivation: TCGA-CDR PFI.time retained unchanged; cannot identify when first-line response was assessed

PFI_event.meaning: TCGA-CDR progression-free-interval status: 1 = PFI event, 0 = censoring
PFI_event.derivation: TCGA-CDR PFI event field retained unchanged

fl_start.base: All labelled TCGA-OV cases; missing if no qualifying first-line record
fl_start.reference: Diagnosis is day 0; 0 is not missing
fl_start.derivation: Earliest eligible primary-tumour, given systemic start under the existing first-line start-window rule; no dates re-derived by reporting script

fl_end.base: All labelled TCGA-OV cases; missing when no regimen end is recorded
fl_end.reference: Diagnosis is day 0; 0 is not missing
fl_end.derivation: Latest available end among existing first-line systemic regimen records under the existing regimen-join rule

fl_agents.meaning: Recorded first-line systemic agents, separated by semicolons
fl_agents.derivation: Agent names aggregated from the recorded first-line regimen; no new treatment classification

regimen.meaning: Descriptive regimen category: Platinum-taxane doublet, Other platinum-based, Non-platinum or No first-line record
regimen.derivation: Existing script-20 category from first-line agents and platinum status; No first-line record is an explicit category, not a missing value

therapy_end.meaning: Recorded end of first-line therapy used as the patient-specific landmark candidate
therapy_end.base: All labelled TCGA-OV cases; not restricted to plausible or landmark-included dates
therapy_end.reference: Diagnosis is day 0; 0 is not missing
therapy_end.derivation: Later of the available first-line systemic and eligible radiotherapy ends under existing rules; not a response-assessment date

main_landmark_cohort.meaning: TRUE = included in the frozen main therapy-end OS landmark cohort; FALSE = excluded
main_landmark_cohort.derivation: Membership in the existing script-17 main patient list, copied by script 20; reporting does not reselect patients

exclusion_reason.meaning: Existing ordered landmark eligibility reason, or included
exclusion_reason.derivation: Existing script-20 hierarchy: no OS; no first-line regimen record; no therapy end date; implausible end date (<60 or >365 d); death/censoring before therapy end; otherwise included

cohort.meaning: External cohort accession: GSE63885, GSE23554 or GSE30161
cohort.base: All rows in the published external sample inventory, including rows without analysable response; not identical to a model complete-case denominator
cohort.reference: not applicable; cohorts are analysed separately
cohort.derivation: Existing primary external cohort identity; retracted cohorts excluded from published Data 2

sample.base: Published external sample inventory; sample identity is within cohort
sample.derivation: GEO or curatedOvarianData sample name retained unchanged

response4.meaning: Available CR/PR/SD/PD label; GSE23554 binary CR/IR metadata does not provide a four-class label
response4.base: Published external sample inventory; not all samples have four-class response
response4.reference: CR when a four-class comparison is available
response4.derivation: GSE63885 clinical status post 1st line (P mapped to PD); GSE30161 author chemoresponse; GSE23554 remains NA rather than inventing PR/SD/PD

noncr.meaning: Binary response: 0 = CR, 1 = Non-CR (PR/SD/PD or unsplit incomplete response)
noncr.base: Published external sample inventory; score/survival models use their own existing available-case subsets
noncr.derivation: Available four-class labels collapsed to CR versus Non-CR; GSE23554 CR/IR mapped directly to 0/1

os_days.meaning: Recorded overall-survival follow-up from diagnosis to death or censoring
os_days.reference: Diagnosis is day 0; 0 is not missing
os_days.derivation: GSE63885 os - overall survival; GSE23554 overall survival in days; GSE30161 curated days_to_death, as retained by script 14; no landmark subtraction here

os_event.derivation: GSE63885 DOD = 1 and AWD/NED = 0; GSE23554 Dead = 1; GSE30161 deceased = 1; original missing status preserved

debulk_optimal.meaning: Cohort-specific debulking indicator: 1 = recorded optimal category, 0 = recorded non-optimal category; definitions are not interchangeable across cohorts
debulk_optimal.base: Published external sample inventory; debulking-adjusted estimates use existing complete-case subsets
debulk_optimal.reference: 0 = non-optimal category in the binary model; not TCGA residual_group R0; 0 is not missing
debulk_optimal.derivation: GSE63885 R0 = 1, R1/R2 = 0; GSE23554 O = 1, S = 0; GSE30161 optimal = 1, suboptimal = 0

grade.meaning: Original cohort-specific grade category (G1-G4 or high/low), without cross-cohort harmonisation
grade.reference: not applicable; no common grade reference is declared
grade.derivation: GSE63885 tumour-grade G code; GSE23554 grade with G prefix; GSE30161 summarygrade retained

stage.meaning: Original available FIGO stage category, not the TCGA I-II/III/IV grouped covariate
stage.reference: not applicable; no external stage-adjusted reference is inferred
stage.derivation: GSE63885 figo_stage retained; other cohorts remain NA where script 14 did not supply stage

patient.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases, including landmark exclusions
patient.derivation: Existing script-31 patient identity; no new patient selection

response4.meaning: Canonical CR/PR/SD/PD first-course response matching Data 1

main_landmark_cohort.meaning: TRUE = frozen main therapy-end OS landmark member; FALSE = excluded
main_landmark_cohort.derivation: Copied from Data 1; flags do not alter membership

fl_start.meaning: Recorded first-line systemic start, exactly matching Data 1
fl_start.reference: Diagnosis is day 0; 0 is not missing
fl_start.derivation: Existing script-31 audit verified agreement with Data 1; reporting copies metadata only

fl_end.meaning: Recorded first-line systemic end, exactly matching Data 1
fl_end.reference: Diagnosis is day 0; 0 is not missing
fl_end.derivation: Existing script-31 audit verified agreement with Data 1; reporting does not re-date cases

therapy_end.meaning: Recorded therapy-end landmark candidate, exactly matching Data 1; not a response-assessment date
therapy_end.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases, including implausible or missing dates
therapy_end.reference: Diagnosis is day 0; 0 is not missing
therapy_end.derivation: Existing script-31 audit verified agreement with Data 1; flags do not change the landmark

regimen_records.meaning: Number of recorded first-line systemic regimen records, including duplicate records
regimen_records.reference: 0 = no qualifying regimen record; 0 is not missing
regimen_records.derivation: Existing script-31 count of qualifying primary-tumour, given first-line systemic records

regimen_end_missing_some.meaning: At least one first-line regimen record lacks an end date
regimen_end_missing_some.base: All labelled TCGA-OV cases; no records means FALSE
regimen_end_missing_some.reference: FALSE = predicate not triggered, not necessarily complete date ascertainment
regimen_end_missing_some.derivation: Existing script-31 FLAG_DEFINITIONS and treatment_date_flag_summary; any regimen end is missing

duplicate_regimen_records.meaning: Identical type/agent/start/end records within the first-line regimen
duplicate_regimen_records.base: All labelled TCGA-OV cases; no records means FALSE
duplicate_regimen_records.derivation: Existing script-31 FLAG_DEFINITIONS and treatment_date_flag_summary; duplicate recorded tuples, without deduplication here

non_chemotherapy_record_in_regimen.meaning: Hormonal, targeted, immunotherapy or unspecified pharmaceutical record in the regimen
non_chemotherapy_record_in_regimen.base: All labelled TCGA-OV cases; no records means FALSE
non_chemotherapy_record_in_regimen.derivation: Existing script-31 FLAG_DEFINITIONS and treatment_date_flag_summary; any regimen record type differs from Chemotherapy

bevacizumab_in_regimen.meaning: Bevacizumab recorded within the first-line regimen window
bevacizumab_in_regimen.base: All labelled TCGA-OV cases; no records means FALSE
bevacizumab_in_regimen.derivation: Existing script-31 FLAG_DEFINITIONS and treatment_date_flag_summary; case-insensitive bevacizumab agent match

bevacizumab_sets_end.meaning: The first-line systemic end is set only by a bevacizumab record
bevacizumab_sets_end.base: All labelled TCGA-OV cases; predicate requires an available systemic end
bevacizumab_sets_end.reference: FALSE = predicate not triggered, not a chart-reviewed negative
bevacizumab_sets_end.derivation: Existing script-31 FLAG_DEFINITIONS and treatment_date_flag_summary; other agents have no end or all recorded other ends are earlier

radiotherapy_extends_end.meaning: Radiotherapy ends after the systemic regimen and sets the therapy end
radiotherapy_extends_end.base: All labelled TCGA-OV cases; predicate requires both recorded systemic and radiotherapy ends
radiotherapy_extends_end.reference: FALSE = predicate not triggered, including when required ends are missing
radiotherapy_extends_end.derivation: Existing script-31 FLAG_DEFINITIONS and treatment_date_flag_summary; radiotherapy end exceeds systemic end

later_systemic_start.meaning: Systemic record starting >42 days after the first start, within the start window
later_systemic_start.base: All labelled TCGA-OV cases; no qualifying later record means FALSE
later_systemic_start.derivation: Existing script-31 FLAG_DEFINITIONS and treatment_date_flag_summary; existing later-record rule, not a new treatment-line adjudication

later_systemic_before_end.meaning: Such a later systemic record starts before the computed first-line end (possible switch)
later_systemic_before_end.base: All labelled TCGA-OV cases; predicate requires an available systemic end
later_systemic_before_end.reference: FALSE = predicate not triggered; TRUE is not proof of a clinical switch
later_systemic_before_end.derivation: Existing script-31 FLAG_DEFINITIONS and treatment_date_flag_summary; later start precedes recorded systemic end

duration_outside_standard.base: All labelled TCGA-OV cases; predicate requires both systemic start and end
duration_outside_standard.reference: FALSE = predicate not triggered, including missing duration; FALSE is not missing
duration_outside_standard.derivation: Existing script-31 FLAG_DEFINITIONS and treatment_date_flag_summary; recorded fl_end minus fl_start outside the existing standard interval

start_before_diagnosis.meaning: First-line start recorded before the diagnosis date
start_before_diagnosis.base: All labelled TCGA-OV cases; missing start means FALSE
start_before_diagnosis.reference: FALSE = predicate not triggered; diagnosis is day 0
start_before_diagnosis.derivation: Existing script-31 FLAG_DEFINITIONS and treatment_date_flag_summary; recorded systemic start < 0

therapy_end_not_plausible.meaning: Therapy end missing or outside 60-365 days
therapy_end_not_plausible.base: All labelled TCGA-OV cases; missing therapy end triggers TRUE
therapy_end_not_plausible.reference: FALSE = recorded therapy end within the existing plausible interval
therapy_end_not_plausible.derivation: Existing script-31 FLAG_DEFINITIONS and treatment_date_flag_summary; descriptive flag only, no new exclusion or date replacement

patient.base: All 454 labelled expression-linked TCGA-OV Data 1 cases, including landmark exclusions; rows sorted by patient
patient.derivation: Data 1 patient copied unchanged by script 32; duplicate identifiers rejected

response4.meaning: Canonical first-course response: CR complete response, PR partial response, SD stable disease, PD progressive disease
response4.reference: CR; NCR-only PD-versus-PR/SD models use PR/SD as reference
response4.derivation: Data 1 canonical TCGA-CDR label copied unchanged by script 32; CR/PR/SD/PD levels verified against R17/R18 and config/analysis.yml

label_source.meaning: TCGA-CDR label availability and concordance with the clinical-matrix label
label_source.derivation: Copied unchanged from Data 1: TCGA-CDR only, TCGA-CDR concordant clinical-matrix label, or TCGA-CDR discordant clinical-matrix label; no relabelling

age.meaning: Age at initial pathological diagnosis, retained unchanged from Data 1
age.reference: not applicable; Inf/-Inf are nonfinite values, not R complete.cases missing values
age.derivation: Data 1 age copied as a source string; underlying TCGA-CDR-linked age with clinical-matrix fallback; script 32 does not add a finite-age exclusion

stage_group.meaning: Source FIGO stage grouped as I-II, III or IV, before the R17/R18 factor-level check
stage_group.derivation: Data 1 stage_group copied unchanged; stage_group_r17 separately records the factor-compatible value

residual_group.meaning: Source postoperative residual disease: R0, 1-10 mm, 11-20 mm or >20 mm, before the R17/R18 factor-level check
residual_group.unit: residual disease category (mm; R0 means no macroscopic disease)
residual_group.derivation: Data 1 residual_group copied unchanged; residual_group_r17 separately records the factor-compatible value

age_10y.meaning: Diagnosis age scaled per ten years for the existing adjusted models; Inf/-Inf retained rather than classified as missing
age_10y.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases; NA when parsed age is missing
age_10y.reference: One unit = ten years; 0 is not missing; Inf/-Inf remain complete under R complete.cases
age_10y.derivation: Script 32 divides parsed Data 1 age by 10, reproducing the script-02 covariate used in R17/R18; number maps blank/NA/NaN to missing but preserves infinity; no imputation or finite-age filter

stage_group_r17.meaning: Stage covariate after applying the existing R17/R18 factor levels I-II, III, IV
stage_group_r17.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases; unavailable or unrecognised source levels become NA
stage_group_r17.derivation: Script 32 retains stage_group only if it is in STAGES, reproducing R17:97 and R18:103 factor definitions; no stage reassignment

residual_group_r17.meaning: Residual-disease covariate after applying the existing R17/R18 factor levels R0, 1-10 mm, 11-20 mm, >20 mm
residual_group_r17.unit: residual disease category (mm; R0 means no macroscopic disease)
residual_group_r17.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases; unavailable or unrecognised source levels become NA
residual_group_r17.derivation: Script 32 retains residual_group only if it is in RESIDUALS, reproducing R17:98 and R18:104 factor definitions; no residual-disease reassignment

age_complete.meaning: TRUE when age/10 is nonmissing under the existing R complete.cases semantics, including Inf/-Inf; not a finite-age indicator
age_complete.reference: FALSE = parsed age missing; FALSE is not missing
age_complete.derivation: Script 32 number(age) is not None; blank/NA/NaN are missing, while Inf/-Inf are retained; reproduces R17 complete.cases(age_10y) without an extra finite-age rule

stage_complete.meaning: TRUE when source stage matches an existing R17/R18 factor level; FALSE for missing or unrecognised levels
stage_complete.derivation: Script 32 stage_group in I-II/III/IV, equivalent to nonmissing stage_group_r17

residual_complete.meaning: TRUE when source residual disease matches an existing R17/R18 factor level; FALSE for missing or unrecognised levels
residual_complete.derivation: Script 32 residual_group in R0/1-10 mm/11-20 mm/>20 mm, equivalent to nonmissing residual_group_r17

covariates_complete.meaning: TRUE when all three existing adjustment covariates are complete; endpoint eligibility is assessed separately
covariates_complete.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases, not just OS or PFI risk-set members
covariates_complete.reference: FALSE; FALSE is not missing; completeness is not a finite-age check
covariates_complete.derivation: Script 32 age_complete AND stage_complete AND residual_complete, reproducing R17/R18 age_10y, stage_group and residual_group complete-case requirements; Inf/-Inf age remains complete

missing_covariates.meaning: Semicolon-separated names of incomplete adjustment covariates, or the explicit category none
missing_covariates.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases; may overlap endpoint exclusion reasons
missing_covariates.reference: none = all three covariates complete; none is not missing
missing_covariates.derivation: Script 32 lists failed age_10y, stage_group, residual_group checks in that order; joins with semicolons or writes none; Inf/-Inf age is not listed as missing

fl_start.meaning: Recorded first-line systemic regimen start, exactly matching Data 1
fl_start.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases, including absent first-line records
fl_start.reference: Diagnosis is day 0; 0 is not missing
fl_start.derivation: Copied unchanged by script 32 from Data 1; no date re-derivation, assessment-date substitution or extra risk-set filter

fl_end.meaning: Recorded first-line systemic regimen end, exactly matching Data 1
fl_end.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases, including missing regimen ends
fl_end.reference: Diagnosis is day 0; 0 is not missing
fl_end.derivation: Copied unchanged by script 32 from Data 1; existing latest available first-line systemic end, not a response-assessment date

therapy_end.meaning: Recorded first-line therapy end used as the patient-specific landmark candidate; not a response-assessment date
therapy_end.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases, including missing or implausible dates
therapy_end.reference: Diagnosis is day 0; 0 is not missing
therapy_end.derivation: Copied unchanged from Data 1; later available systemic/eligible radiotherapy end under existing rules; script 32 checks plausibility without replacing, imputing or re-dating it

therapy_end_status.meaning: Ordered landmark-origin status: therapy_end_missing, therapy_end_nonfinite, therapy_end_below_plausible_window, therapy_end_above_plausible_window, or plausible
therapy_end_status.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases; missing/nonfinite statuses are explicit categories, not missing dictionary values
therapy_end_status.reference: plausible = finite therapy end within 60-365 diagnosis-relative days, inclusive
therapy_end_status.derivation: Script 32 origin_status checks parsed missingness, nonfiniteness, <60, then >365 in order, otherwise plausible; bounds copied from config/analysis.yml, reproducing R17/R18 date_ok

therapy_end_plausible.meaning: TRUE when recorded therapy end is finite and within the existing inclusive 60-365-day window; not sufficient for endpoint eligibility
therapy_end_plausible.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases; missing or nonfinite therapy end yields FALSE
therapy_end_plausible.reference: FALSE; FALSE is not missing; diagnosis is day 0
therapy_end_plausible.derivation: Script 32 therapy_end_status == plausible, reproducing R17:99 and R18:105 without a new date rule

origin_days.meaning: Patient-specific therapy-end landmark origin on the diagnosis-relative day scale, available only for plausible recorded therapy ends
origin_days.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases; NA for missing, nonfinite or out-of-window therapy end even when a raw date is retained
origin_days.reference: Diagnosis is day 0; not elapsed follow-up or a response-assessment date; 0 is not missing
origin_days.derivation: Script 32 copies therapy_end unchanged if plausible, otherwise NA, reproducing R17 therapy_end origin and R18 lm_main; endpoint times remain diagnosis-relative in this CSV, with subtraction only in the existing models

main_landmark_cohort.meaning: TRUE = frozen main therapy-end OS landmark member; FALSE = excluded; not a PFI membership flag
main_landmark_cohort.derivation: Copied unchanged from Data 1 by script 32 and checked against independently reproduced os_eligible; no patient reselection or restriction of PFI to this flag

response_assessment_date_provided.meaning: FALSE for every case because real first-line response-assessment dates were not provided; does not imply no clinical assessment occurred
response_assessment_date_provided.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases; constant FALSE in the completed audit
response_assessment_date_provided.reference: FALSE = date not provided; FALSE is not missing
response_assessment_date_provided.derivation: Script 32 records False explicitly; neither therapy_end nor PFI_days is treated as an assessment date, and no assessment time is inferred

os_days.meaning: Recorded overall-survival follow-up interval from diagnosis to death or censoring; not post-landmark elapsed time
os_days.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases, including endpoint/landmark exclusions
os_days.reference: Diagnosis is day 0; 0 is not missing; nonfinite values are distinct from missing and fail os_days_finite
os_days.derivation: Script 32 copies Data 1 OS_days source string unchanged, retaining TCGA-CDR OS.time; no origin subtraction or assessment-date conversion

os_event.meaning: Recorded overall-survival status: 1 = death event, 0 = censoring; for excluded cases this is not a post-landmark event count
os_event.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases, including endpoint/landmark exclusions
os_event.derivation: Script 32 copies Data 1 OS_event unchanged and asserts each nonmissing parsed status is 0 or 1; no new outcome adjudication

os_days_finite.meaning: TRUE when recorded OS days are nonmissing and finite; not an indicator of survival beyond the landmark
os_days_finite.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases; missing or nonfinite OS days yield FALSE
os_days_finite.reference: FALSE; FALSE is not missing; a finite 0 would yield TRUE
os_days_finite.derivation: Script 32 finite(number(Data 1 OS_days)); reproduces the R17/R18 finite endpoint-time requirement

os_event_not_missing.meaning: TRUE when OS event status is available, including censoring coded 0
os_event_not_missing.reference: FALSE = parsed status missing; FALSE and status 0 are not missing dictionary values
os_event_not_missing.derivation: Script 32 number(Data 1 OS_event) is not None; nonmissing statuses are separately asserted binary, reproducing R17/R18 !is.na(event)

os_eligible.meaning: TRUE = existing unadjusted therapy-end OS risk-set member, constructed independently of PFI
os_eligible.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases; no PFI or covariate-completeness restriction
os_eligible.derivation: Script 32 os_exclusion_reason == included: plausible finite origin, finite OS days, nonmissing binary OS status and OS days strictly greater than origin; reproduces R17:108-119/R18:117-124 and verifies Data 1 main membership; no extra fl_start or regimen filter

os_adjusted_eligible.meaning: TRUE = common covariate-complete subset of the existing full-response OS risk set for age+stage+residual adjustment
os_adjusted_eligible.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases; adjusted membership requires OS eligibility and all three existing covariates
os_adjusted_eligible.reference: FALSE; FALSE is not missing; not the NCR-only effective denominator
os_adjusted_eligible.derivation: Script 32 os_eligible AND covariates_complete, reproducing R17:144-146/R18:130-132 complete cases; age completeness retains Inf/-Inf, not an added finite-age rule; counts checked against the unique existing OS therapy_end age+stage+residual topology row

os_exclusion_reason.meaning: Mutually exclusive hierarchical OS landmark exclusion reason, or included; separate from covariate incompleteness and Data 1's reporting hierarchy
os_exclusion_reason.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases, not restricted first to another endpoint; explicit missingness reasons are categories
os_exclusion_reason.reference: included; date flags may overlap but this reason has one value per case
os_exclusion_reason.derivation: Script 32 endpoint_reason takes the first applicable reason: therapy_end_missing, therapy_end_nonfinite, therapy_end_below_plausible_window (<60), therapy_end_above_plausible_window (>365), endpoint_days_missing, endpoint_days_nonfinite, endpoint_event_missing, then event_at_or_before_landmark (OS days <= origin and status 1) or censor_at_or_before_landmark (OS days <= origin and status 0); otherwise included. Missing covariates only affect adjusted eligibility, not this reason

os_event_at_or_before_landmark.meaning: Recorded OS death occurs on or before a plausible therapy-end landmark
os_event_at_or_before_landmark.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases; requires plausible therapy end and finite OS days; flags may overlap other descriptive flags
os_event_at_or_before_landmark.reference: FALSE = predicate not triggered, including unavailable comparison inputs; FALSE is not missing
os_event_at_or_before_landmark.derivation: Script 32 therapy_end_plausible AND os_days_finite AND os_event == 1 AND os_days <= origin_days; diagnoses set day 0; recorded pre/on-landmark death, not a post-landmark event

os_censor_at_or_before_landmark.meaning: Recorded OS censoring occurs on or before a plausible therapy-end landmark
os_censor_at_or_before_landmark.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases; requires plausible therapy end and finite OS days; flags may overlap other descriptive flags
os_censor_at_or_before_landmark.reference: FALSE = predicate not triggered, including unavailable comparison inputs; FALSE is not missing; event status 0 is censoring
os_censor_at_or_before_landmark.derivation: Script 32 therapy_end_plausible AND os_days_finite AND os_event == 0 AND os_days <= origin_days; diagnosis is day 0; no assertion about unobserved later survival

pfi_days.meaning: Recorded TCGA-CDR progression-free interval from diagnosis to PFI event or censoring; not a response-assessment date or post-landmark elapsed time
pfi_days.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases, including OS and PFI exclusions
pfi_days.reference: Diagnosis is day 0; 0 is not missing; nonfinite values are distinct from missing and fail pfi_days_finite
pfi_days.derivation: Script 32 copies Data 1 PFI_days source string unchanged, retaining TCGA-CDR PFI.time; no origin subtraction, assessment-time inference or OS-based truncation

pfi_event.meaning: Recorded TCGA-CDR PFI status: 1 = PFI event, 0 = censoring; for excluded cases this is not a post-landmark event count
pfi_event.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases, including OS and PFI exclusions
pfi_event.derivation: Script 32 copies Data 1 PFI_event unchanged and asserts each nonmissing parsed status is 0 or 1; no outcome or assessment-date re-derivation

pfi_days_finite.meaning: TRUE when recorded PFI days are nonmissing and finite; not an indicator of remaining event-free beyond the landmark
pfi_days_finite.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases; missing or nonfinite PFI days yield FALSE
pfi_days_finite.reference: FALSE; FALSE is not missing; a finite 0 would yield TRUE
pfi_days_finite.derivation: Script 32 finite(number(Data 1 PFI_days)); reproduces the R17 finite endpoint-time requirement independently of OS

pfi_event_not_missing.meaning: TRUE when PFI event status is available, including censoring coded 0
pfi_event_not_missing.reference: FALSE = parsed status missing; FALSE and status 0 are not missing dictionary values
pfi_event_not_missing.derivation: Script 32 number(Data 1 PFI_event) is not None; nonmissing statuses are separately asserted binary, reproducing R17 !is.na(event) independently of OS

pfi_eligible.meaning: TRUE = existing unadjusted therapy-end PFI risk-set member, built independently from all labelled cases rather than from the OS main cohort
pfi_eligible.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases; neither os_eligible nor main_landmark_cohort nor covariate completeness is an input restriction
pfi_eligible.reference: FALSE; FALSE is not missing; observed nesting within OS does not define the PFI construction rule
pfi_eligible.derivation: Script 32 pfi_exclusion_reason == included: plausible finite origin, finite PFI days, nonmissing binary PFI status and PFI days strictly greater than origin; reproduces R17:108-119/178-179 independently of OS; no extra fl_start or regimen filter; counts checked against the unique existing PFI therapy_end none topology row

pfi_adjusted_eligible.meaning: TRUE = common covariate-complete subset of the independently built full-response PFI risk set for age+stage+residual adjustment
pfi_adjusted_eligible.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases; requires PFI eligibility and existing covariates, not prior OS membership
pfi_adjusted_eligible.derivation: Script 32 pfi_eligible AND covariates_complete, reproducing R17:144-146 complete cases with Inf/-Inf age retained rather than a finite-age filter; counts checked against the unique existing PFI therapy_end age+stage+residual topology row

pfi_exclusion_reason.meaning: Mutually exclusive hierarchical PFI landmark exclusion reason, or included; independent of OS exclusion reasons and covariate incompleteness
pfi_exclusion_reason.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases, never restricted first to the OS cohort; explicit missingness reasons are categories
pfi_exclusion_reason.reference: included; descriptive date flags may overlap but this reason has one value per case
pfi_exclusion_reason.derivation: Script 32 endpoint_reason takes the first applicable reason: therapy_end_missing, therapy_end_nonfinite, therapy_end_below_plausible_window (<60), therapy_end_above_plausible_window (>365), endpoint_days_missing, endpoint_days_nonfinite, endpoint_event_missing, then event_at_or_before_landmark (PFI days <= origin and status 1) or censor_at_or_before_landmark (PFI days <= origin and status 0); otherwise included. Missing covariates only affect adjusted eligibility; PFI later than OS is not an exclusion rule

pfi_event_at_or_before_landmark.meaning: Recorded PFI event occurs on or before a plausible therapy-end landmark
pfi_event_at_or_before_landmark.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases; requires plausible therapy end and finite PFI days, not OS membership; flags may overlap
pfi_event_at_or_before_landmark.reference: FALSE = predicate not triggered, including unavailable comparison inputs; FALSE is not missing
pfi_event_at_or_before_landmark.derivation: Script 32 therapy_end_plausible AND pfi_days_finite AND pfi_event == 1 AND pfi_days <= origin_days; diagnosis is day 0; recorded pre/on-landmark event, not an assessment date or post-landmark event

pfi_censor_at_or_before_landmark.meaning: Recorded PFI censoring occurs on or before a plausible therapy-end landmark
pfi_censor_at_or_before_landmark.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases; requires plausible therapy end and finite PFI days, not OS membership; flags may overlap
pfi_censor_at_or_before_landmark.reference: FALSE = predicate not triggered, including unavailable comparison inputs; FALSE is not missing; event status 0 is censoring
pfi_censor_at_or_before_landmark.derivation: Script 32 therapy_end_plausible AND pfi_days_finite AND pfi_event == 0 AND pfi_days <= origin_days; diagnosis is day 0; no inference of an assessment time

os_main_flag_matches_data1.meaning: TRUE when independently reproduced OS eligibility equals the frozen Data 1 main-landmark flag, including agreement on exclusions
os_main_flag_matches_data1.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases; TRUE for all 454 audited cases, not just included cases
os_main_flag_matches_data1.reference: FALSE = disagreement and audit failure; FALSE is not missing; TRUE does not itself mean OS membership
os_main_flag_matches_data1.derivation: Script 32 compares os_eligible with Data 1 main_landmark_cohort == TRUE for each patient and rejects any mismatch

ncr_unadjusted_eligible.meaning: TRUE = NCR-only unadjusted OS risk-set member for the existing R18 PD-versus-PR/SD analysis and shared power-design denominator
ncr_unadjusted_eligible.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases; selected cases have PR/SD/PD and OS eligibility, without covariate-completeness restriction
ncr_unadjusted_eligible.reference: FALSE; FALSE is not missing; PR/SD is the NCR PD-step reference
ncr_unadjusted_eligible.derivation: Script 32 os_eligible AND response4 != CR, reproducing R18:368-369; existing audit summary records 99 patients/80 OS events, the shared design counts retained for both R18 power-table rows, not the adjusted model's effective denominator; no fitting or new power calculation

ncr_adjusted_eligible.meaning: TRUE = effective covariate-complete NCR-only OS denominator for the existing adjusted R18 PD-versus-PR/SD model (reported HR 1.52)
ncr_adjusted_eligible.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases; selected cases have PR/SD/PD, OS eligibility and complete age_10y/stage_group/residual_group
ncr_adjusted_eligible.reference: FALSE; FALSE is not missing; PR/SD is the NCR PD-step reference; not the shared power-design denominator
ncr_adjusted_eligible.derivation: Script 32 os_adjusted_eligible AND response4 != CR reproduces the R18:370 covariate-complete model subset, retaining R complete.cases semantics for Inf/-Inf age; existing audit summary records 92 patients/75 OS events, distinct from the shared 99/80 design counts retained by R18:375-383; no model refit or power recomputation

pfi_later_than_os_descriptive.meaning: Finite recorded PFI days exceed finite recorded OS days; descriptive only, not an automatic error or exclusion
pfi_later_than_os_descriptive.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases, including landmark exclusions; requires both finite endpoints, not a plausible origin
pfi_later_than_os_descriptive.reference: FALSE = predicate not triggered, including unavailable/nonfinite endpoints; FALSE is not missing
pfi_later_than_os_descriptive.derivation: Script 32 before(parsed OS_days, parsed PFI_days); compares diagnosis-relative endpoint dates without re-dating, imputing assessment time or changing either risk set

fl_end_before_fl_start.meaning: Finite recorded first-line systemic end precedes finite recorded first-line systemic start
fl_end_before_fl_start.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases; requires both finite dates; flags may overlap and do not change risk-set membership
fl_end_before_fl_start.reference: FALSE = predicate not triggered, including unavailable/nonfinite dates; FALSE is not missing
fl_end_before_fl_start.derivation: Script 32 before(parsed fl_end, parsed fl_start) on the diagnosis-relative day scale; no date correction

therapy_end_before_fl_start.meaning: Finite raw recorded therapy end precedes finite first-line systemic start
therapy_end_before_fl_start.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases, including implausible finite therapy ends; no plausible-origin requirement; flags may overlap
therapy_end_before_fl_start.reference: FALSE = predicate not triggered, including unavailable/nonfinite dates; FALSE is not missing
therapy_end_before_fl_start.derivation: Script 32 before(parsed therapy_end, parsed fl_start) on the diagnosis-relative day scale; descriptive comparison of raw dates, not a new exclusion or date replacement

therapy_end_before_fl_end.meaning: Finite raw recorded therapy end precedes finite recorded first-line systemic end
therapy_end_before_fl_end.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases, including implausible finite therapy ends; no plausible-origin requirement; flags may overlap
therapy_end_before_fl_end.reference: FALSE = predicate not triggered, including unavailable/nonfinite dates; FALSE is not missing
therapy_end_before_fl_end.derivation: Script 32 before(parsed therapy_end, parsed fl_end) on the diagnosis-relative day scale; descriptive only, without modifying dates or eligibility

os_days_before_diagnosis.meaning: Finite recorded OS days are negative relative to diagnosis
os_days_before_diagnosis.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases; requires finite OS days, not plausible therapy end; flags may overlap
os_days_before_diagnosis.reference: FALSE = predicate not triggered, including unavailable/nonfinite OS days; FALSE is not missing; day 0 is not negative
os_days_before_diagnosis.derivation: Script 32 os_days_finite AND parsed OS_days < 0; diagnosis is day 0; no new date correction or additional inclusion rule

pfi_days_before_diagnosis.meaning: Finite recorded PFI days are negative relative to diagnosis
pfi_days_before_diagnosis.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases; requires finite PFI days, not plausible therapy end or OS membership; flags may overlap
pfi_days_before_diagnosis.reference: FALSE = predicate not triggered, including unavailable/nonfinite PFI days; FALSE is not missing; day 0 is not negative
pfi_days_before_diagnosis.derivation: Script 32 pfi_days_finite AND parsed PFI_days < 0; diagnosis is day 0; no assessment-time inference or new inclusion rule

pfi_eligible_not_os_eligible.meaning: TRUE = independently constructed PFI member who is not an OS member; descriptive risk-set difference
pfi_eligible_not_os_eligible.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases; unadjusted endpoint-specific risk sets built independently
pfi_eligible_not_os_eligible.reference: FALSE; FALSE is not missing; all observed values are FALSE, which does not impose OS nesting on PFI
pfi_eligible_not_os_eligible.derivation: Script 32 pfi_eligible AND NOT os_eligible; independent PFI construction is also checked with an in-memory sentinel, not an added CSV patient; no membership changes

os_eligible_not_pfi_eligible.meaning: TRUE = independently constructed OS member who is not a PFI member; descriptive risk-set difference
os_eligible_not_pfi_eligible.base: All labelled TCGA-OV Data 1 cases; unadjusted endpoint-specific risk sets built independently
os_eligible_not_pfi_eligible.reference: FALSE; FALSE is not missing; observed risk-set differences do not define a PFI selection rule
os_eligible_not_pfi_eligible.derivation: Script 32 os_eligible AND NOT pfi_eligible; no OS-first restriction, date replacement or new statistical analysis
